author: Y Combinator
description:
Reusable rockets are about to dramatically increase humanity's capacity to put things in space, and that means an enormous new market for compute built to operate there.

We want to see inference chips optimized for mass, thermal, and radiation tolerance, built for a world where space is no longer out of reach.

Apply to YC Summer 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Electronics in Space

author: Y Combinator
description:
A Patriot missile costs $3 million. An FPV drone costs $500. All the cost advantage lies with the attackers, and the next wave isn't one drone, it's swarms.

Drone defense is starting to look less like operating a weapon and more like running a real-time distributed system. We want to fund founders building the counter-swarm stack.

Apply to YC Summer 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Counter-Swarm Defense

author: Y Combinator
description:
Every company has critical know-how scattered across people's heads, old Slack threads, support tickets, and databases, and AI agents can't operate like that.

We think every company in the world is going to need a new primitive: a living map of how the company works that turns its own artifacts into an executable skills file for AI.

Apply to YC Summer 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Company Brain
